description: This file defines an Android SQLite database helper class 'AppDatabase' for managing a trading journal, including creation and upgrade logic for the 'trades' table, as well as a singleton pattern for database access.

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Android SQLiteOpenHelper implementation for trading journal database, using raw SQL statements, with singleton pattern for access.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the trades table in the database when the database is first created.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the database by dropping and recreating the trades table when schema version changes.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides a thread-safe singleton instance of the AppDatabase class.
